name: Quick-Witted's stab triggers Searing Quiver's Fire Arrows (#13043)
contract: Quick-Witted 704311 (Ranger, Brigand) fires its stab 704314 when you avoid an attack. #13043 reports that
the stab did not apply the quiver's effects. Searing Quiver 500103 tooltips that ranged abilities deal $s1%
(15%) additional direct Fire damage as Fire Arrows 681109, computed from the damage the hit actually dealt;
the stab is DmgClass 3 (ranged) but triggered, which the Ranger quiver hit handler skipped. Expected: each
stab is followed by Fire Arrows worth about 15% of the stab (a critical Fire Arrows doubles it), so the Fire
Arrows total stays between 10% and 50% of the stab total. The mob has 1,000,000 health so overkill never
trims the stab, Evasion (5277, +50% dodge) makes avoided attacks frequent, and the ranger never attacks, so
every Fire Arrows comes from a stab.
